products.title: Book Engineering Session
products.body_html:
This service is designed specifically for music product houses, to provide them with high-quality engineering and audio services.

With this product, you can book a one-hour session with our experienced audio engineers, who will work with you to enhance the audio quality of your music product. Whether it's editing, mixing, mastering or any other audio-related task, our engineers have the expertise and equipment to deliver outstanding results.

During the session, you'll have the opportunity to discuss your specific requirements and preferences with the engineer, and they will work closely with you to ensure that your music product is of the highest quality. Our engineers are also able to provide valuable feedback and suggestions based on their vast experience in the field.

Not only do we provide top-notch audio services, but we also offer a hassle-free booking process. Simply select a date and time that works for you, and our engineers will be ready to work with you at your convenience. Plus, with our competitive pricing, you'll receive excellent value for money.

In summary, "Book an Engineering Session for 1 Hour" is the perfect solution for music product houses looking to enhance the audio quality of their products. With experienced engineers, top-quality equipment, and a simple booking process, we guarantee that you'll be satisfied with the results. So, book your session today and take the first step towards creating exceptional audio products.

products.title: Disco Sundays™ Hoodie
products.body_html:
If there’s one fashion rule to live by, let it be that comfort doesn’t have to be compromised for the sake of style. Pair the super-soft unisex eco raglan hoodie with joggers for a relaxed look, or elevate the outfit with a skirt, oversized blazer, or classic trousers. The hoodie’s brushed inside ensures a comfy and snug feel, and will keep you warm during the colder days.

• Outside: 100% organic cotton
• Charcoal melange is 60% cotton, 40% recycled polyester
• Inside for all colors: 80% organic cotton, 20% recycled polyester
• Brushed lining
• Regular fit
• Raglan sleeves
• Ribbed cuffs and hem
• Drawstrings with metal eyelets and stoppers
• Jersey-lined hood
• Blank product sourced from Bangladesh

This product is made especially for you as soon as you place an order, which is why it takes us a bit longer to deliver it to you. Making products on demand instead of in bulk helps reduce overproduction, so thank you for making thoughtful purchasing decisions!
